gitCommit.subject: Corpus round 2: 19 new fault scenarios + collect-corpus CI job
gitCommit.body:
Corpus round 2: 19 new fault scenarios + collect-corpus CI job

New scenarios: 10 product, 7 test, 1 environment, 1 flake (43 total). Adds a workflow_dispatch job (collect-corpus) that collects scenarios on Linux runners, distills new runs, regenerates the fine-tune dataset, and uploads runs/ + finetune/ as artifacts.
